receipt.local.text: Your browser recorded what was sent while it was written: nothing left this device.
receipt.inCloud.text: Your conversation was sent to the cloud to write this answer.
receipt.unknown.text: Your browser’s record of what was sent while it was written wasn’t kept.
receipt.save.text: Shows how this answer was made, never its words: anyone can have it.
receipt.proof.text: Adds the request and the answer, for those who may read them.
receipt.log: Record them in a public log, {host}: public and permanent
